title: Local decision connected with भाव और विचार की समझ
scenario: A learner encounters a real-life situation where भाव और विचार की समझ and शब्दार्थ और संदर्भ pull the decision in different directions. The learner must use evidence and reasoning rather than guesswork.
tasks: Identify the decision to be made.

title: Transfer case: पाठ से प्रमाण
scenario: A new situation resembles an idea from 'तीन बुद्धिमान' but includes a different condition. Learners must decide whether the chapter concept still applies.
tasks: Decide what transfers and what does not.
